mutants.rationale: Drop the fiber-constancy hypothesis: claim every question over three histories factors through the image of a report.
Confuse factoring through the image with the report being injective: only 6 injective reports, 48 pairs.
Read uniqueness on the image as uniqueness of the extension to all reports; unreported points leave s^(v-k) free values.
Claim off-image non-uniqueness also when the report is surjective, where there is no off-image point.
Count every report as having full image, ignoring that the image of a report can be smaller than the codomain.
Claim one question over two histories factors without being fiber constant (or conversely); the criterion is an iff.
Claim a question has two distinct factorizations through the image; uniqueness on the image is a theorem.
Treat the empty history set as a refusal case; the empty question factors through the empty image, vacuously.
Count answers constant on the fibers of the constant report (a coarser equivalence than the own kernel of each report): 27 reports times 2 answers, instead of the own fibers of each report.
Claim the empty question over the empty history set extends to the two-element report type in one way; with no answer values there are none (s^v = 0), although it factors through the empty image.
